source.title: Linking Dynamic Phenotyping with Metabolite Analysis to Study Natural Variation in Drought Responses of Brachypodium distachyon
source.version: Frontiers in Plant Science 7:1751, version of record, published 2016-11-29
source.locator: Materials and Methods: Plant Material and Phenotyping of Drought Induced Physiological Changes; Results: Phenotypic Analyses of 10 Selected Brachypodium Lines, including Fig. 4; Discussion: Screening and Ecotype Selection
source.license: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0), stated in the article copyright notice
source.scope: Controlled greenhouse and Smarthouse drought experiment. Although 10 ecotypes were selected for detailed phenotyping, the authors excluded flowering Bd21 from further phenotypic and metabolomic analyses; the claim concerns the remaining selected accessions under the stated treatment, not wild populations or species-wide field tolerance.

source.attribution: Fisher LHC, Han J, Corke FMK, Akinyemi A, Didion T, Nielsen KK, Doonan JH, Mur LAJ, Bosch M (2016). Linking Dynamic Phenotyping with Metabolite Analysis to Study Natural Variation in Drought Responses of Brachypodium distachyon. Front Plant Sci. 7:1751. https://doi.org/10.3389/fpls.2016.01751. Claims paraphrased.

claim.text: In a controlled greenhouse and Smarthouse drought experiment, the nine selected Brachypodium distachyon ecotypes retained for phenotypic analyses separated by previously screened drought-response group under a 12-day treatment targeting 0% soil water content: the tolerant group showed greater plant height and side-view projected area, and fewer grey and yellow pixels, than the susceptible group. These results describe the selected accessions under this imposed treatment, not species-wide field drought tolerance.
claim.textZh: 在温室与 Smarthouse 控水试验中，进入表型分析的九个 Brachypodium distachyon 选定生态型，在以土壤含水量 0% 为目标、持续 12 天的处理下，按前期筛选的干旱响应组表现出差异：耐受组的株高和侧视投影面积较大，灰色与黄色像素较少。该结果仅描述这些选定材料在此处理下的表现，不代表全物种的野外耐旱性。
claim.locator: Results, Phenotypic Analyses of 10 Selected Brachypodium Lines and Fig. 4; the article states Bd21 flowered and was excluded from further phenotypic analyses.
claim.placeTimeScope: National Plant Phenomics Centre, Aberystwyth University, Wales, UK; greenhouse/Smarthouse experiment before flowering. Daily imaging covered the 12-day treatment from days 34 to 45 after sowing; day/night temperatures were 22°C/20°C; the severe treatment targeted 0% soil water content.
claim.lifeStatus: Selected diploid inbred ecotypes grown under controlled glasshouse conditions. The experiment was not a field survey and does not directly characterize wild populations.

gaps: The drought-response evidence comes from a controlled experiment on selected accessions and does not establish species-wide field tolerance, natural population frequencies, or performance across other life stages and environments.
